newsitem.title: UK: UK's SFO says in touch with IMRO over Morgan probe.
newsitem.headline: UK's SFO says in touch with IMRO over Morgan probe.

text.p: The UK's Serious Fraud Office said on Thursday it was in contact with the Investment Management Regulatory Organisation over IMRO's probe into suspected irregularities at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management funds.
"We have been in contact with IMRO. IMRO are investigating and will share anything of relevance with us," an SFO spokeswoman said.

Trading in three European funds run by MGAM was suspended on Monday and resumed earlier today amid an investigation by MGAM and IMRO, the British investment funds watchdog, into suspected irregularities at the funds. MGAM has suspended two of its fund managers, Peter Young and Stewart Armer.
Earlier on Thursday, the SFO said it was not investigating Morgan Grenfell Asset Management or Young or Armer.
